title: collab P4: inbound asset sync has no size cap and no content-hash verification (DoS + integrity)
description:
FIXED. Inbound asset RESPONSE hardening in packages/authoring-ui/src/collab.

(1) SIZE CAP — exported MAX_ASSET_BYTES = 64 MiB from assetChannel.ts. Enforced at 3 layers: (a) transport webrtcAssetTransport.onPeerData drops a data-channel message > MAX_ASSET_BYTES+1024 before it reaches the engine; (b) decode() returns null for a RESPONSE whose declared body > cap, BEFORE subarray/slice copies it (no OOM); (c) AssetSyncEngine.handle() re-checks actual byte length defensively.

(2) CONTENT-HASH VERIFY — handle() recomputes sha256Hex(receivedBytes) (from @flash/core fla/asset-hash.ts) and DROPS the RESPONSE unless it equals the requested hash. Poisoned/crafted bytes are a no-op; store never poisoned; placeholder stays until honest bytes arrive (first-CORRECT-writer-wins). Never internalizes unverified bytes.

TESTS (assetChannel.test.ts, +3 adversarial): oversized RESPONSE dropped without put() ever called; hash-mismatch RESPONSE rejected while honest matching bytes still resolve; valid within-cap RESPONSE resolves. Two existing loopback tests updated to store bytes under their canonical sha256. assetSync2peer.test.ts 2-peer gate still passes.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green; authoring-ui 1144/1144 pass; @flash/collab 24/24 pass; docs/37-collab.md §12.7 added.
